title: Las Vegas Monster Truck Driving Experience
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Drivers of any vehicle must have a driver's license
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the thrill of driving a real Monster Truck—the only opportunity of its kind in Las Vegas! Enjoy round-trip transportation from select Strip hotels to “The Mountain,” where you’ll take the wheel for a 20-minute adventure on a custom off-road track. With complimentary water and coffee included, this unforgettable experience promises pure adrenaline and memories to last a lifetime.
